notes:
Back now returns to the screen you were actually on. In Settings and Account it steps back one level at a time instead of jumping straight to the home screen, and on a title page it closes the open episode first. The on-screen back arrow and the remote's Back button now do exactly the same thing.

Picking a stream has been rebuilt. Opening a title is its own page now, sources appear on their own without a separate Choose stream step, and an addon dropdown sits where Play used to be so you can switch between AIOStreams, Torrentio and the rest. Each source card shows quality, codec, audio and size when the addon provides them.
